figures.learning_pipeline: Two exposure decisions. Entry policies size proposals within each signal; a separately fitted Q policy chooses the capital split between funded strategy indices.
figures.signal_example: AMD minus NVDA selected-put IV in 2019. Shading marks excursions outside historical percentile boundaries, not executed trades. Gaps are unavailable quotes. Daily contract selection makes this a signal series, not the mark of one held contract.
figures.straddle_bridge: Full-history straddle account, January 2018–August 2025. The option and stock components are read together; the remaining cash flows reconcile them to profit above cash.
figures.straddle_paths: The same 2,599 cohorts grouped by their completed price paths. Combined profit includes option charges but precedes stock-hedge charges, dividends and financing. The grouping is descriptive.
figures.straddle_ivrv: Combined option and hedge profit by completed price path and entry IV versus subsequent RV. These are realized-outcome groups, not new entry screens; totals depend on counts and sizes.
figures.straddle_examples: Two selected cohorts: a large hedge gain (left) and loss (right). Rows show spot versus strike, shares carried into each session, and cumulative option, stock and combined profit. Security IDs are stable identifiers.
figures.refit_timeline: Monthly put-policy refitting. Only completed outcomes whose signal dates fall in the displayed 18-month window enter each fit. The selected model settings remain fixed; the tree and size assignments update.
figures.feature_validation: Original feature exploration at the 18-month baseline. Scores use 2018–2021 validation and the archived $345 million research account; funded policy comparisons use $10 million. The three highest scores tie exactly.
figures.entry_policy: The original tree/CEM construction. The three-state maps illustrate candidates; actual trees have up to eight states. Each candidate selects action-specific completed paths; the best 19 update sampling probabilities. The retained map sizes next month’s proposals.
figures.entry_curves: Profit above cash since January 2022. Upper right: total straddle profits. Lower right: incremental straddle profit, bandit minus fixed full sizing. Series subtract their 2021 closing values and retain carried positions. Differences reflect both sizing and admission.
figures.entry_explanations: Put bars show the share of visited tree nodes; straddle bars show size changes when one input is centered. The denominators differ. Both are descriptive policy-usage measures.
figures.allocation_risk: Bandit-managed source portfolios; nine-input Q state and γ = 0.99. Gray labels are fixed straddle percentages; the remainder goes to put pairs. Lines connect discrete policies. Both axes have the same scales across periods; 2025 ends in August.
figures.allocation_schedule: Weekly target decisions during evaluation, before next-close execution. The remaining weight goes to put pairs. These are requested strategy allocations, not drifted portfolio holdings or individual trade sizes.
figures.conditional_risk: Realized straddle returns after λ = 0.20 Q decisions. Straddle-only choices cover 220 sessions; put-only choices cover 678. The four mixed-allocation intervals are omitted. Source costs are included; outer resizing charges are excluded.
figures.factorial: Cell values are annualized excess Sharpe at λ = 0.20. Fixed entry size is 100%; fixed capital allocation is 50/50. Q is independently fitted on each entry family’s actual returns and costs.
figures.straddle_management: Separate joint-contract management trial, January 2022–August 2025. Upper panel: compounded growth relative to cash. Lower panel: cumulative daily excess-return difference, conditional cuts minus unchanged 90/10. This is not the Q-index account.
